FIELDS.NAME: TalentLink Employment Services
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At TalentLink Employment Services, we specialize in connecting employers with qualified candidates across various industries, focusing primarily on permanent placements for professional roles in non-regulated sectors. Our core operations involve thorough vetting of candidates to ensure compliance with local and federal regulations, including conducting background checks and verifying work eligibility prior to placement. We maintain all required state and federal licenses to operate legally and adhere to high standards of professionalism and ethical recruitment. Written contracts outlining terms of service are provided to both clients and candidates to clarify responsibilities and prevent disputes. Our team is committed to protecting candidate and client data, employing secure systems in compliance with applicable privacy laws. Additionally, we strive for excellence by regularly updating our internal processes, ensuring our recruitment practices align with the industry's best standards. Overall, TalentLink aims to foster lasting relationships between employers and candidates, promoting successful career placements that benefit both parties.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: TalentLink Training Solutions, LLC - An affiliated workforce development program that provides training and upskilling services to enhance candidate qualifications and employability.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 02/15/2021; Cause: Candidate placed in a temporary role experienced a slip and fall incident resulting in minor injuries; Amount: $3,200; Status: Resolved with no outstanding claims.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class: Office, Grade: A, Label: Secure
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel services provided during high-recruitment events and client on-site evaluations to ensure a safe hiring process.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – TalentLink Employment Services does not engage in storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing of, or transporting hazardous materials in any of its operations. Our focus is primarily on connecting employers with qualified candidates in non-regulated sectors.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – TalentLink Employment Services does not sponsor athletic teams as part of its business operations. Our primary focus is on connecting employers with qualified candidates in various industries.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. Certificates are checked by our compliance manager to ensure proper risk management and coverage.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – TalentLink Employment Services has not had any applicant indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime in connection with this or any other property. We maintain rigorous vetting procedures to ensure compliance and uphold our professional standards.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – TalentLink Employment Services has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We maintain good standing with our insurance provider and uphold all necessary compliance requirements.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – TalentLink Employment Services does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our focus is on permanent placements and connecting qualified candidates with employers directly.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – TalentLink Employment Services carries Workers' Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and provide coverage for our employees. This policy is active and reflects our commitment to maintaining a safe work environment.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – TalentLink Employment Services owns and operates an affiliated business, TalentLink Training Solutions, LLC, which focuses on providing training and upskilling services to enhance candidate qualifications and employability.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – TalentLink Employment Services does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. We maintain our current policy and focus on our core operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – TalentLink Employment Services is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations focus solely on connecting employers with qualified candidates.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – TalentLink Employment Services does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our business operations focus solely on employment and recruitment services without involving equipment rental or loan activities.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – TalentLink Employment Services has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. We maintain sound financial practices to ensure stability and compliance.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – TalentLink Employment Services does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations are focused solely on employment and recruitment services in non-regulated sectors.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – TalentLink Employment Services does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused on employment and recruitment in non-regulated sectors, without engaging in activities that carry such risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – TalentLink Employment Services has not experienced any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We maintain rigorous compliance and vetting procedures to prevent such issues.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – TalentLink Employment Services currently does not have any uncorrected fire code violations. We prioritize compliance with safety regulations and conduct regular inspections to ensure our facilities meet all necessary requirements.
